debt.description: Debt positions including first and second lien senior secured loans, subordinated loans, revolvers, delayed draws, structured secured notes, and convertible bonds

other.description: Other private-market positions such as royalty rights and the exact reconciled Rocade Holdings LLC row

known_edge_cases.description: Identifiers use comma-delimited issuer, optional industry, and instrument text through 2025-09-30, then mostly switch to pipe-delimited issuer and instrument text starting 2025-12-31.

Same issuer and instrument text can appear multiple times in a quarter with different rate, value, or economic fields. These remain separate position-level rows upstream and must not be borrower-aggregated.

Some rows expose only issuer text. This wrapper only classifies the exact recurring Rocade Holdings LLC row observed as reconciled OTHER and does not broad-match arbitrary issuer-only text because it would hide residuals that need source reconciliation review.
